name: OptSigNet
description: Introduction OptSignNet is a dataset comprising of 10,050 undirected signed graphs, with known frustration index, that is, the optimal flips required to balance them. Hence forming a benchmark to test balancing algorithms on. We 2010 graphs each of Erdos-R\'enyi, Watts-Strogatz, Barab\'asi-Albert, Power Law Cluster and Stochastic Block Model. We have also included the optimal answer for each graph stored in a separate file of the same name in the Optimal_Flips folder. Data Description Each file contains basic elements of a signed graph, which are: `node1`, `node2` and `sign` signifying that there exist node1 and node2 they have an edge connecting them with positive(`+`) or negative(`-`) `sign`. While the optimal answer file just has `node1` and `node2` denoting the edges you may need to flip to balancing the graph optimally. Folder Structure OptSigNet/├── ER/├── BA/├── WS/├── PL/├── SBM/└── index.csv Optimal_Flips/├── ER/├── BA/├── WS/├── PL/├── SBM/
